*F-auth* (Authenticated transmission) is part of *Layer 1: Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti. [*Universally composable signature, certification, and authentication*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2003/239). In 17th IEEE Computer Security Foundations Workshop (CSFW), pages 219–233, 2004.
- Bellare, Canetti, and Krawczyk. [*A modular approach to the design and analysis of authentication and key exchange protocols*](https://eprint.iacr.org/1998/009). In 30th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), 1998.
